dossier.public_summary: The dip appears deep and flat in some transits but vanishes to a shallow unstable depth in others with the same instrument, so it is not a consistent transit. Most of the folded signal comes from a few outliers in one sector. Centroid shows on-target but the depth systematics point to systematic contamination, not a planet.

reasons.why: Depth changes dramatically between sectors, not a calibration offset.
reasons.value: sector 42 depth_ppm 3655 err_ppm 1222, sector 55 depth_ppm 10545 err_ppm 891, sector 82 depth_ppm 7502 err_ppm 791, sector 92 depth_ppm 93433 err_ppm 1431; chi2 3164, dof 3, p_constant 0, depth_change_pct 311.9

reasons.why: Variation persists within TESS-SPOC alone, so not just pipeline difference, but true instability of the signal.
reasons.value: changes_within_a_source; QLP depth_ppm 93433 err_ppm 1431, TESS-SPOC depth_ppm 7858 err_ppm 532, p_constant 2.5844165304161007e-05

reasons.why: Signal is driven by a few extremely deep outliers in one sector, a classic few-bad-events false positive; a planet should be consistent.
reasons.value: 17 transits, share_of_top_3 0.722, outliers depth_ppm 95938 sigma 28.0 (epoch 63), 93680 sigma 27.2 (epoch 59), 92910 sigma 26.9 (epoch 62), 91202 sigma 26.3 (epoch 60); p_consistent 0.0

reasons.why: Shape appears flat-bottomed only after averaging inconsistent depths; high impact parameter and transit duration mismatch density, consistent with off-target/blended/eclipsing binary, not a planet.
reasons.value: rp_rearth 4.853, duration ratio 1.404, shape v_sigma -6.983, but fit_b 0.8553, star_density_penalty 1198, fit_log_density_ratio -2.159

reasons.why: Independent ML rank is low, supporting false positive as planet-like evidence is outweighed by depth instability.
